scope: Development only. Recall questions over this repository's own notes (TRACKER.md, IMPROVEMENTS.md, docs/how-it-works.md), written by hand on 2026-11-24 the way a new agent session would ask. `gold` is a verbatim phrase that must appear in a returned chunk. No evals/git1 input is used. `also` lists further verbatim phrases that answer the question equally; added after the first run, where a retrieved chunk answered but lacked the original phrase. The runner reports strict (gold only) and full scores.
